brand.lead: AppChat is a One-Person Company (OPC) platform that helps one person build, run and grow a business with a team of AI Agents — the full customer lifecycle from Marketing → Sales → Service → Success in one system.
brand.slogan: One person. One business. Run by AI.

login.title: Welcome back 👋
login.sub: Sign in to your workspace to keep running your omnichannel conversations.
login.otpHint: A 6-digit code will be sent to your email — no password needed.
login.remember: Keep me signed in for 30 days
login.securityBody: SSO / SAML · 2FA · Role-based access · Audit log — built for Vietnamese businesses.

register.title: Create your account
register.sub: Verify by email — get an activation code, no password needed. 15-day trial, no card required.
register.resendIn: Didn't get the code? Resend in {time}
register.verifiedSub: Your account has been created. Complete your profile to start using the workspace.
register.chanZaloSub: Coming soon — needs a Zalo OA

forgot.title: Forgot password?
forgot.sub: Enter your work email. We'll send a reset link within 30 seconds.
forgot.sentBody: Check {email} and click the link to reset your password. The link is valid for 15 minutes.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.sub: Create a new password for your account. The link is valid for 15 minutes only.
reset.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalid: The link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
